title: Sycophancy Hides Linearly in the Attention Heads

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the 'Sycophancy Rate', defined as the proportion of instances where the model changes an initially correct answer to an incorrect one following simulated user disagreement, using factual Q&A datasets like TruthfulQA. The study also uses linear probes on internal model activations (such as attention heads) to detect and steer this deference behavior.
